title: FOMC communications blackout begins (through 2027-03-18)
source: EST: federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/files/fomc-blackout-period-calendar.pdf — PDF re-downloaded (HTTP 200, 98,013 bytes) and its content streams inflated in-session 2026-09-05. It is titled '2025-2027 FOMC Trading and External Communications Blackout Calendar' (so it spans 2027) and contains a MARCH 2027 grid; its footnote states the policy verbatim: 'The blackout period will begin at 12:00 a.m. Eastern Time the second Saturday before a meeting and end at 11:59 p.m. Eastern Time the day after a meeting. For example, if the Committee meeting starts on a Tuesday, the blackout period will begin at the start of the Saturday that falls ten days earlier, and if the meeting ends on a Wednesday, the blackout period will end at the end of Thursday.' Mar 16 2027 is a Tuesday and Mar 17 a Wednesday, so the source's own worked example gives Saturday 2027-03-06 through Thursday 2027-03-18 with no inference of ours. INDEPENDENTLY CONFIRMED without re-doing the work: fomc-blackout-start-2027-01-16's initial research decoded the same PDF's vector grid shading directly (text-matrix composition plus cell hit-testing, legend grey 0.851 = 'Blackout dates', validated first against the 2026 page) and returned all eight 2027 windows, of which the second is Mar 6-18 — the Board's own highlighting, matching this arithmetic exactly. Filed estimate rather than confirmed because it is a firm rule applied to a TENTATIVE meeting date: fomccalendars.htm states every 2027 date is 'tentative until confirmed at the meeting immediately preceding it', so the promotion trigger is the 2027-01-27 meeting, not a better fetch. Discovered during the fomc-2027-03-17 initial research, checked 2026-09-05
notes: The gate around the FIRST SEP of 2027 (fomc-2027-03-17, estimate), which is what makes it worth a slot rather than a duplicate of the decision entry. Two things that lane established give this window its character. (1) FORMAT: the Fed's own projections FAQ, fetched 2026-09-05, states verbatim that 'the projections made in March and June are for the current year, for the subsequent two years, and for the longer run' against September/December's 'subsequent three years' — and seven SEP tables parsed that session (Dec-2024 through Jun-2026) confirm the rule has run without exception. So the March 2027 SEP publishes 2027/2028/2029/longer run, the IDENTICAL forward set December 2026 will, making it the year's first pure-revision dot plot and the only December-to-March comparison with no horizon-extension artifact in it. The eleven days this gate covers are the last window in which any participant can shape expectations before that revision lands, and it is the first SEP published after Warsh's five task forces — one on communications — are due to conclude by year-end 2026 (registered as FT-fomc-2027-03-17-1, not asserted). (2) CORRIDOR: the gate closes at the end of Thursday 2027-03-18, so the first legal Fed voice after this meeting comes only on Friday 2027-03-19 — which is US quarterly triple witching (opex-2027-03-19, estimate) AND Japan's February national CPI (japan-cpi-2027-03-19, estimate), with the Bank of Japan's own decision (boj-decision-2027-03-18, estimate) inside the gate's final day. The gate also swallows the S&P Select Sector rebalance reference close (sp-rebalance-reference-close-2027-03-12, estimate) and the March VIX/VXM expiration, which AM-settles and stops trading 09:00 ET on 2027-03-17 itself — roughly five hours before the decision (vix-expiration-2027-03-17, estimate), so March VIX exposure unpins BEFORE the dots land rather than after. Five tracked events inside eleven days with no Fed able to interpret any of them, the same structural asymmetry fomc-blackout-start-2026-11-28 measured for December's jobs and CPI prints. Measured in the fomc-2027-03-17 ledger and relevant to sizing that window: the two sessions between the dot plot and the expiry carry a mean absolute S&P move of 1.10% with a mean of +0.03% across the seven years the March FOMC fell two sessions before triple witching — as large as the decision day itself and directionless — while the expiry session is 0.61% whether or not an FOMC preceded it. Estimate widens caution only; promote once the 2027-01-27 meeting confirms the 2027 calendar, and the date re-derives from whatever it confirms.
